templates.name: AI Addendum
templates.description: Addendum to an existing agreement governing the provider's AI services, including use of customer input and output and restrictions on training AI models with customer data.

templates.name: Business Associate Agreement
templates.description: HIPAA Business Associate Agreement setting out how a provider may use, disclose and safeguard protected health information (PHI) on behalf of a covered entity.

templates.name: Cloud Service Agreement
templates.description: Standard SaaS agreement covering a customer's subscription to and use of a cloud service, including fees, confidentiality, warranties, liability and termination.

templates.name: Data Processing Agreement
templates.description: Agreement governing a provider's processing of customer personal data as a processor or subprocessor, including GDPR-style obligations, subprocessors, security and international transfers.

templates.name: Design Partner Agreement
templates.description: Agreement giving an early-stage design partner access to a product in exchange for feedback, covering product access, feedback rights, confidentiality and term.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement
templates.description: Standard terms of a mutual NDA under which both parties may share confidential information for a stated purpose and must protect it.

templates.name: Mutual Non-Disclosure Agreement Cover Page
templates.description: Cover page for the Mutual NDA capturing the deal-specific terms (purpose, effective date, MNDA term, governing law, jurisdiction) and party signatures.

templates.name: Partnership Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a business partnership between two companies, covering each party's obligations, trademark licensing, feedback, confidentiality and termination.

templates.name: Pilot Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a limited-time pilot or trial of a product for evaluation purposes before a customer commits to a full purchase.

templates.name: Professional Services Agreement
templates.description: Agreement for a provider to perform professional services and deliverables under statements of work (SOWs), including fees, IP ownership, warranties and liability.

templates.name: Service Level Agreement
templates.description: Service level terms for a cloud service, defining target uptime, response times, service credits and the customer's remedies for missed targets.

templates.name: Software License Agreement
templates.description: Agreement licensing on-premise or downloadable software to a customer, covering license scope, restrictions, fees, warranties and liability.
